summary: Register an OAuth integration in Notion so users can authorize your app to access their Notion workspaces. You will need to provide app details and a redirect URI, and public apps may require Notion's approval before users can install them.
requirements: An HTTPS redirect URI for handling OAuth callbacks

steps.text: Go to Notion's developer/integrations settings and create a new integration.
Enter your app name, logo, description, and redirect URI.
Save the generated client ID and client secret.
Submit the app for review if you want it available to all Notion users as a public integration.
Implement the OAuth authorization flow in your application using the obtained credentials.

blockers: Public OAuth apps may require approval from Notion before end users can install them; internal integrations are typically limited to your own workspace.
Redirect URIs typically must use HTTPS and match exactly.
Client secrets must be stored securely and never exposed in client-side code.
